brief:
Israeli Culture Minister Miki Zohar threatened Sunday to strip citizenship from the award-winning directors of an Israeli documentary about Gaza, accusing them of treason. The threat targets filmmakers behind the Israeli-made film that has garnered international recognition.

Zohar's comments represent an escalation in tensions over the documentary's content and messaging regarding the Gaza conflict. The specific allegations and the filmmakers' responses were not detailed in available reports.

title: Israeli minister threatens to revoke citizenship of Gaza documentary filmmakers
